children: On the Auction Date, between 10:30 am and 11:00 am, the Government Debt Management will auction Treasury bills in the Series, with the ISIN numbers and with the Maturity Dates according to the table above. Payments for the Treasury bills must be received by the Central Bank before 14:00 on the Settlement Date and the Bills will be delivered in electronic form on the same day.

Please note that the Treasury bill RIKV 27 0317 will be registered electronically at Verðbréfamiðstöð Íslands hf. central securities depository (VBM). The Treasury bill RIKV 26 1216 is registered at Nasdaq CSD.

For additional information please contact Oddgeir Gunnarsson, Government Debt Management, at +354 569 9635.

title: Treasury Bill Auction Announcement - RIKV 26 1216 - RIKV 27 0317
